title: Automated quant-profile validation harness and deployment safeguards for model pinning
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an automated validation and publishing pipeline for quantization profiles (INT8 / FP8 / GPTQ / AWQ) that integrates with model version pinning and our catalog publishing workflow. The harness will run functional and perf regressions on candidate quant profiles, surface deterministic quality deltas against a curated prompt suite, and gate publishing/rollout with configurable rollback triggers. This is intended to reduce manual review time, prevent silent regressions after profile publishing, and standardize metrics used for pin decisions.
acceptance_criteria: CI job 'quant-validate' runs for new quant profiles and produces a deterministic artifact with perf & quality metrics
Profiles with quality regressions beyond thresholds are automatically marked 'blocked' in the catalog and cannot be pinned to active customer deployments
Publish pipeline annotates model catalog entries with quant_profile metadata (profile_id, format, kernel_hint, expected_latency_pct, memory_delta)
Canary rollout automation supports shadowing and 1% traffic cohorts and will auto-rollback when telemetry triggers fire
tasks: Define canonical evaluation prompt set (500 prompts across classification, summarization, instruction-following, code) and expected model outputs baseline
Implement 'quant-validate' CI job that runs: unit tests, functional output comparison, eval-suite scoring, perf microbenchmarks (p50/p95 token latency, throughput), and memory footprint measurement
Add telemetry events for quant_profile.name, quant_profile.id, hw_target, kernel_selected, token_latency_ms, batch_size, error_rate, eval_score_delta
Extend model catalog schema to accept quant_profile metadata and pin constraints (pin_by_version, allowed_variants)
Author dashboard in Grafana showing P50/P95 latency by profile, eval score delta time series, and rollback events
Create a GitHub action to publish validated quant profiles to the staging catalog and open a PR for manual review if any non-critical discrepancies exist
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Run harness in CI for all PRs touching quant configs (no publishing) — 2 weeks
Phase 2: Enable auto-blocking for profiles that fail hard thresholds; publish to 'staging' catalog and run 7-day shadow traffic tests — 1 week
Phase 3: Canary releases: 1% traffic cohort on dedicated instances with live telemetry; monitor 72 hours — 1 week
Phase 4: Gradual promotion to GA with automated rollback policy if thresholds exceeded — final week
regression_thresholds: Latency: p95 increase > 10% relative to baseline triggers warning; > 25% triggers immediate block/rollback
Throughput: drop > 15% triggers fail for throughput-sensitive routes
Quality: eval-suite absolute score drop > 2.0 points (or relative > 3%) triggers hard block
Perplexity-like metrics: > 5% degradation flagged for manual review
Error rate: > 0.5% increase over baseline triggers investigation
automation_hooks: CI job: .github/workflows/quant-validate.yml (runs on PRs and nightly)
Rollback handler: /ops/quant-rollback (automated lambda invoked by alerting rule)
